nodes.label: ANCOVA
nodes.rationale: Combines ANOVA and regression, adjusting group means for a continuous covariate.

nodes.label: Repeated Measures ANOVA
nodes.rationale: Accounts for correlated measurements taken on the same subjects over time.

nodes.label: Generalized Linear Mixed Model (GLMM)
nodes.rationale: Adds random effects to GLMs to model grouped/hierarchical data.

nodes.label: Autocorrelation Function (ACF/PACF)
nodes.rationale: Diagnoses temporal dependence and guides ARIMA order.

nodes.label: ARIMA Models
nodes.rationale: Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average models for forecasting time series.

nodes.label: Time Series Analysis
nodes.rationale: Analyzes temporally ordered data.

nodes.label: Correlation
nodes.rationale: Measures strength and direction of association between two variables.

nodes.label: Linear Regression
nodes.rationale: Models the linear relationship between a response and predictor.

nodes.label: Multiple Linear Regression
nodes.rationale: Extends linear regression to several predictors.

nodes.label: Completely Randomized Design
nodes.rationale: Simplest ANOVA design; treatments randomly assigned to all units.

nodes.label: Randomized Block Design
nodes.rationale: Controls for a nuisance variable by grouping units into blocks, increasing power.

nodes.label: Factorial ANOVA
nodes.rationale: Tests main effects and interactions between multiple factors.

nodes.label: Type II/III Sums of Squares
nodes.rationale: Choice of SS type matters for unbalanced factorial designs.

nodes.label: ANOSIM
nodes.rationale: Tests for differences in community composition between groups using rank dissimilarities.

nodes.label: mvabund
nodes.rationale: Model-based multivariate abundance analysis with distribution assumptions.

nodes.label: SIMPER
nodes.rationale: Identifies species contributing most to community dissimilarity.

nodes.label: Data Frame
nodes.rationale: Core tabular data structure in R for storing variables in columns.

nodes.label: Variable Transformation
nodes.rationale: Transform variables to meet analysis assumptions.

nodes.label: Rayleigh Test
nodes.rationale: Tests for uniformity vs unimodal concentration of circular data.

nodes.label: Data Distributions in Ecology
nodes.rationale: Poisson, binomial, negative binomial etc. model count and proportion data.

nodes.label: Generalized Linear Model (GLM)
nodes.rationale: Relaxes Gaussian/linearity assumptions via link functions and non-normal error distributions.

nodes.label: Negative Binomial GLM
nodes.rationale: Handles overdispersed count data.

nodes.label: Generalized Estimating Equations (GEE)
nodes.rationale: Models correlated/clustered data by specifying a working correlation structure.

nodes.label: Zero-Inflated Negative Binomial (ZINB)
nodes.rationale: ZIP variant for overdispersed zero-inflated counts.

nodes.label: Zero-Inflated Poisson (ZIP)
nodes.rationale: Models count data with excess zeros via a mixture of a count and a zero process.

nodes.label: Generalized Additive Model (GAM)
nodes.rationale: Models non-linear relationships using smooth spline functions.

nodes.label: Spatially-Explicit GLM/GAM
nodes.rationale: Incorporates spatial autocorrelation into models via autocovariates or spatial smooths.

nodes.label: Grammar of Graphics
nodes.rationale: ggplot2 provides a layered grammar (data, aesthetics, geometries) making complex, reproducible graphics.

nodes.label: Non-metric Multidimensional Scaling (nMDS)
nodes.rationale: Ordination based on rank dissimilarities, suited to ecological community data.

nodes.label: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
nodes.rationale: Linear ordination reducing many correlated variables to few components.

nodes.label: Akaike Information Criterion (AIC)
nodes.rationale: Balances model fit and complexity for model selection.

nodes.label: Model Averaging
nodes.rationale: Combines predictions across multiple candidate models weighted by information criteria.

nodes.label: Regression Trees
nodes.rationale: Non-parametric recursive partitioning for prediction.

nodes.label: One-way ANOVA
nodes.rationale: Compares means across more than two groups.

nodes.label: Chi-square Test
nodes.rationale: Tests association between categorical variables.

nodes.label: Fisher Exact Test
nodes.rationale: Exact test for categorical data with small samples.

nodes.label: Kruskal-Wallis Test
nodes.rationale: Non-parametric alternative to ANOVA.

nodes.label: t-test
nodes.rationale: Compares means of two groups under normality assumption.

nodes.label: Wilcoxon / Mann-Whitney Test
nodes.rationale: Non-parametric alternative to t-test when normality fails.

nodes.label: MANOVA
nodes.rationale: Extends ANOVA to multiple dependent variables simultaneously, accounting for their correlation.

nodes.label: Rarefaction Curves
nodes.rationale: Standardizes species richness comparisons across sampling effort.

nodes.label: Bayesian workflow (7 steps)
nodes.rationale: Fitting is not pressing a button: choose likelihood, priors with prior predictive check, fit, check convergence, posterior predictive checks, interpret, compare via LOO

nodes.label: Frequentist vs Bayesian inference
nodes.rationale: Bayesian answers the question we actually care about (probability of an effect given data) instead of p-values; posterior compromises prior and data, priors stabilize small field datasets

nodes.label: How to report a Bayesian model
nodes.norm_label: how to report a bayesian model
nodes.rationale: Reviewers are more familiar with frequentist results; report likelihood, priors with justification, software, diagnostics, PPC, credible intervals, prior sensitivity; avoid 'significance'

nodes.label: Weakly informative priors
nodes.rationale: Default flat priors on slopes allow absurd values (e^50 change); normal(0,1) on log scale rules out nonsense without pushing results
